name: Elijah Mwangi
intro: I build software that makes complex work easier. I design the interfaces people use, build the systems behind them, and write about what I learn along the way.
biography: I'm a software engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya. I enjoy working across a product, connecting clear interfaces with the systems and services that make them work.
My experience spans .NET and C# backend development, React and Angular interfaces, and applications for finance, education, commerce, and business operations.
This is a home for the projects I've worked on and the things I learn along the way.

experience.description: I lead the engineering team at Kamsware, guide software architecture decisions, and see projects through from planning to deployment.
Worked on applications and websites for fire protection solutions, including work with .NET and ML.NET.

experience.role: ALC Open Source Contributor · Backend Engineer (C#/.NET)
experience.description: I contributed to the architecture and backend development of the Mentor Management System for the Andela Learning Community (ALC).
Worked on response, distribution, and business applications, with .NET Core, ASP.NET, and single-page interfaces.
Built React interfaces for payment systems and participated in work on the Nairobi revenue collection system and Jambo Pay portal.
Worked on interfaces for financial and banking products, including internet banking, core banking, and business management applications.
Helped develop websites and applications for company use.
Worked on the company website, publication design, and a system for financial record keeping.
